labels.label: not_relevant

evidence.quote: planning to begin neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy with one of the protocol-specified chemotherapy regimens
Participants must not have previously received neurotoxic chemotherapy for any reason

labels.note: Neuropathy-prevention supportive study for patients starting neo/adjuvant taxane chemo; not a treatment option here.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Disease must be Stage IV as defined in Section 4.0, or recurrent
the patient must have received at least one line of a platinum-based chemotherapy regimen or anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy
Patients must have Zubrod performance status 0-1

labels.note: Previously treated stage IV NSCLC progressing; RET fusion not among the excluded drivers.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: NSCLC with a sensitizing EGFR mutation and have radiologically or clinically progressed

labels.note: Requires EGFR-mutant disease after osimertinib; patient is EGFR negative with RET fusion.
